criteria.title: Lossless verification

intent.request: Verify file fidelity and the complete collection census after transfer. No LIMIT, top-N or prefix may decide parity: enumerate the full population, record omitted/unreadable entries explicitly, retain complete evidence and provide a cursor/resume or rerun path for any bounded pass. Acceptance requires zero unresolved omissions or mismatches. If new batching code is introduced, native tests cover N-1/N/N+1, decisive records after the boundary, consumer recovery, permutations and restart fairness.

Read all manifest rows and explicit omission counts. Counts are estimatedDocumentCount metadata rather than exact countDocuments, and corroborate rather than replace the cold byte checksum. Enumerate config.system.sessions TTL deletion and local.startup_log startup additions with causes, without silently excluding either namespace. The grade must state the evidenced no-bounded-pass/no-new-batching branch, or cite every required native boundary/recovery test and consume every recovery handle; an unsupported conditional or truncated view cannot pass.
